runtime_disclosure: Browser VM execution is client-side through WebVM/CheerpX. Its writable guest overlay is stored in browser IndexedDB under an image- and guest-generation-specific identifier so ordinary reloads can preserve guest artifacts. Mission Control uses localStorage for conversation continuity: the visible index contains up to eight conversations and restoration reads at most sixteen turns per conversation, but removing an entry from the index does not erase the separate stored conversation record. The inspected client does not implement automatic time-based expiry for those conversation records. Records can include the latest accepted build bundle, subject to client file-count and size limits. Session diagnostics use sessionStorage for environment, lifecycle, provider-stage and failure information and can be downloaded by the visitor. Diagnostic trimming uses JavaScript string length, not a guaranteed 1 MiB byte cap. Redaction rules are not a guarantee of anonymity; review downloads before sharing. A guest-generation identifier is also stored in sessionStorage. Service-worker and runtime storage support the requested VM. These records are not a hosted RESIDUAL account or server-side workspace. Closing a tab or restarting a guest does not necessarily erase localStorage, IndexedDB, caches, downloads or provider records. The Pages build is configured to remove the upstream Plausible script and reject eager Puter loading; model requests require separate authorization. Loading runtime assets still makes network requests to their delivery services. The exact served asset inventory and provider-controlled handling require review for each deployment.
international_processing: Website delivery and optional features can involve processing outside your country. GitHub's privacy statement describes processing in the United States and other countries where it, its affiliates or service providers operate, and its own use of European Commission Standard Contractual Clauses for certain transfers. Puter states that it may store, process and transmit data in Canada and other locations worldwide. Authorized model requests may also be processed by the selected upstream AI service; its processing locations and terms depend on the selected service. Correspondence sent to our published Gmail address is handled by Google for email delivery and storage. Google states that it maintains servers around the world and that information may be processed outside the country where an individual lives. Runtime-asset delivery can involve separate service providers and network-request metadata. Browser-local storage is distinct from these external requests; client-side execution is not a promise that no data leaves your device. RESIDUAL does not offer country-specific data residency for hosting, email, runtime delivery or optional model requests. The providers' statements describe their own practices and do not establish that RESIDUAL has executed a separate data-processing agreement or assessed every transfer. Where international-transfer rules apply to an operator-controlled flow, the applicable legal requirements must be satisfied before that flow proceeds. Ordinary browsing, provider loading and prompt authorization are not treated as a blanket waiver of those requirements. Contact the privacy address above for information about operator-handled transfers and any applicable safeguards.
